title: Ismail Ismail – WordPress developer and accessibility QA
description: Ismail Ismail builds accessible, easy-to-edit WordPress websites and runs WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility QA. Open-source projects on GitHub.
name: Ismail Ismail
hero_lead_html: I build accessible, easy-to-edit WordPress websites and run WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility QA for businesses and NGOs in Bulgaria. Here are all of my public projects.
projects_intro: Plugins, themes and apps built with accessibility in mind, for keyboard, screen reader and phone users. This list updates automatically from GitHub every day.
about_title: Accessibility is at the core of everything I build
about_p1: I love supporting and developing WordPress. I build websites and themes that everyone can use and edit easily, and I check existing websites against WCAG 2.2 AA.
about_p2: Many of my projects are made to work entirely with a keyboard and a screen reader, because accessibility is not an extra: it is part of quality.
focus_3: Testing with keyboard and screen readers (NVDA, JAWS)
contact_text: Have a WordPress site that needs to become accessible, or need a WCAG check? Get in touch through my website.
